bodies: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
National Fire Protection Association Marine Chemist Qualification Board
National Association of State Boating Law Administrators

exams.name: Able Seafarer-Deck Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: STCW deck rating under Regulation II/5 requiring assessed competencies in navigation watch support, mooring and cargo handling.

exams.name: Able Seafarer-Engine Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: STCW engine rating under Regulation III/5 covering watchkeeping support, machinery operation and engine room maintenance tasks.

exams.name: Able Seaman Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Deck rating issued in grades from Special to Unlimited, requiring sea service plus an examination in seamanship and safety.

exams.name: ABYC Diesel Engines Certification
exams.blurb: Marine technician certification on diesel propulsion installation, fuel systems, cooling, exhaust and troubleshooting to ABYC standards.

exams.name: ABYC Gasoline Engines Certification
exams.blurb: Certification on inboard and sterndrive gasoline engine service, ignition protection, ventilation and fuel system standards.

exams.name: ABYC Marine Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Certification
exams.blurb: Certification covering marine chilled water and direct expansion systems, seawater cooling, refrigerants and onboard installation practice.

exams.name: ABYC Marine Corrosion Certification
exams.blurb: Certification on galvanic and stray current corrosion, bonding systems, anodes and cathodic protection surveys for boats.

exams.name: ABYC Marine Electrical Certification
exams.blurb: Widely held marine technician certification covering AC and DC systems, shore power, bonding and ABYC E-11 wiring standards.

exams.name: ABYC Marine Systems Certification
exams.blurb: Certification spanning steering, fuel, plumbing, ventilation, LPG and other onboard systems assessed against ABYC standards.

exams.name: ABYC Standards Certification
exams.blurb: Certification demonstrating working knowledge of the full ABYC standards manual and federal boat construction regulations.

exams.name: American Sailing 101 Basic Keelboat Sailing
exams.blurb: Entry sailing certification covering points of sail, tacking, gybing, rules of the road and crew overboard recovery on small keelboats.

exams.name: American Sailing 103 Basic Coastal Cruising
exams.blurb: Certification for skippering an auxiliary-powered sailboat of about 25 to 35 feet in moderate coastal conditions by day.

exams.name: American Sailing 104 Bareboat Cruising
exams.blurb: Certification for chartering and skippering a 30 to 45 foot cruising sailboat, including provisioning, anchoring and systems management.

exams.name: Apprentice Mate (Steersman) of Towing Vessels
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Entry towing endorsement requiring 30 days of deck service and an examination before a mariner may begin supervised wheelhouse training.

exams.name: Assistance Towing Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Optional endorsement added to an OUPV or Master licence allowing the holder to tow disabled recreational vessels for hire.

exams.name: Auxiliary Sail Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Endorsement permitting a licensed operator to work on sail or auxiliary sail vessels after qualifying sea service and an exam module.

exams.name: Chief Engineer (Limited) Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Engineering licence for chief engineers on vessels of limited horsepower and tonnage, tested on motor and steam plant operation.

exams.name: Chief Mate Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Senior deck licence for vessels of any gross tons, requiring management-level STCW training plus extensive Coast Guard examination modules.

exams.name: Company Security Officer Course
exams.blurb: Approved course preparing shoreside personnel to develop and maintain vessel security plans under the ISPS Code and MTSA.

exams.name: Designated Duty Engineer Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Engineering licence for sole-engineer vessels, issued in horsepower tiers and requiring exams on diesel plants, electrical and auxiliary systems.

exams.name: Facility Security Officer Course
exams.blurb: Training required for officers responsible for security plans, drills and access control at MTSA-regulated waterfront facilities.

exams.name: First Class Pilot Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Route-specific federal pilotage endorsement earned by round trips over the route and a chart examination drawn from memory.

exams.name: Lifeboatman Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Rating endorsement requiring practical assessment in launching and handling survival craft, matched by the STCW proficiency in survival craft.

exams.name: Marine Chemist Certification
exams.body: National Fire Protection Association Marine Chemist Qualification Board
exams.blurb: Certification allowing a chemist to issue safe-for-workers and safe-for-hot-work certificates on vessels under NFPA 306.

exams.name: Master of Towing Vessels
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Licence to command towing vessels on a specified route, earned through a towing officer assessment record and Coast Guard examination.

exams.name: Master of Vessels 1600 Gross Tons
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Deck licence for oceans, near coastal or inland service on vessels up to 1600 gross tons, requiring multi-module Coast Guard examinations.

exams.name: Master of Vessels 500 Gross Tons
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Mid-tier deck licence for vessels up to 500 gross tons covering navigation, stability, cargo handling and rules of the road.

exams.name: Master of Vessels Any Gross Tons
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Highest deck licence authorising command of vessels of unlimited tonnage on oceans, subject to management-level STCW and extensive exams.

exams.name: Master of Vessels Less Than 100 GRT
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Widely held captain licence for inspected passenger vessels under 100 gross tons, tested on deck general, deck safety, rules and chart plot.

exams.name: Master of Vessels Less Than 200 GRT
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Deck licence for vessels under 200 gross tons requiring additional sea service and examination beyond the 100 ton master level.

exams.name: Master of Vessels Less Than 25 GRT
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Entry master licence assigned when a mariner qualifying sea service is on vessels of very small tonnage under 46 CFR 11.422.

exams.name: Master of Vessels Less Than 50 GRT
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Master licence tier assigned from documented tonnage history, authorising command of inspected vessels under 50 gross tons.

exams.name: Mate (Pilot) of Towing Vessels
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Wheelhouse licence permitting a mariner to stand a navigation watch aboard towing vessels after completing assessed towing competencies.

exams.name: Mate of Vessels Less Than 200 GRT
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Deck licence authorising watchkeeping as mate on inspected vessels under 200 gross tons on inland or near coastal routes.

exams.name: Merchant Mariner Credential
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Single credential book that consolidates all officer, rating and STCW endorsements a United States mariner holds.

exams.name: Merchant Mariner Medical Certificate
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Medical and physical fitness certificate required alongside the merchant mariner credential, based on the CG-719K examination.

exams.name: NAMS Certified Marine Surveyor
exams.blurb: Peer-reviewed surveyor credential requiring documented experience, sample surveys and examination in yachts, cargo or hull and machinery.

exams.name: NASBLA-Approved Boating Safety Course
exams.body: National Association of State Boating Law Administrators
exams.blurb: Nationally approved recreational boating course covering navigation rules, required equipment and emergencies, accepted by most states.

exams.name: NMEA 2000 Network Installer Certification
exams.blurb: Certification on designing, wiring and troubleshooting NMEA 2000 backbone networks for marine navigation and engine data.

exams.name: NMEA Marine Electronics Installer Certification
exams.blurb: Tiered certification for technicians installing radar, chartplotters, autopilots, VHF and interfaced navigation electronics on vessels.

exams.name: Operator of Uninspected Passenger Vessels
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Entry captain licence allowing carriage of up to six paying passengers on uninspected vessels for inland, Great Lakes or near coastal routes.

exams.name: Ordinary Seaman Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Entry-level deck rating requiring no sea service, used as the starting endorsement for new mariners joining a vessel crew.

exams.name: Qualified Member of the Engine Department
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Engine rating covering oiler, fireman-watertender, junior engineer and refrigerating engineer roles, earned by sea service and examination.

exams.name: Radar Observer (Inland) Certification
exams.blurb: Short course and practical assessment on radar navigation and collision avoidance for inland and river route mariners.

exams.name: Radar Observer (Unlimited) Certification
exams.blurb: Approved course covering radar plotting, relative motion, ARPA principles and collision avoidance for unlimited tonnage service.

exams.name: Rating Forming Part of a Navigational Watch
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: STCW deck rating requiring assessed steering, lookout and watchkeeping competencies for service on seagoing vessels.

exams.name: Rating Forming Part of an Engineering Watch
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: STCW engine rating certifying competence to keep an engine room watch under the direction of a licensed engineer officer.

exams.name: SAMS Accredited Marine Surveyor
exams.blurb: Accreditation for marine surveyors requiring experience, continuing education and an examination on survey practice and standards.

exams.name: Second Mate Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Unlimited-tonnage deck licence above third mate, requiring additional sea service and Coast Guard examination modules.

exams.name: Ship's Cook Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Steward department endorsement requiring approved food safety training and sea service before a mariner may serve as ship cook.

exams.name: STCW Advanced Firefighting
exams.blurb: Approved course on shipboard fire command, fixed systems, fire investigation and casualty control required for officer endorsements.

exams.name: STCW Automatic Radar Plotting Aids
exams.blurb: Approved course on ARPA target acquisition, trial manoeuvres, system limitations and errors for officers in charge of a navigational watch.

exams.name: STCW Basic Training
exams.blurb: Four-module STCW course covering personal survival, basic firefighting, elementary first aid and personal safety and social responsibility.

exams.name: STCW Bridge Resource Management
exams.blurb: Approved course on bridge teamwork, situational awareness, communication and error management for watchkeeping deck officers.

exams.name: STCW Electronic Chart Display and Information Systems
exams.blurb: Approved course on electronic chart systems, route planning, alarms, sensor inputs and ECDIS limitations for navigating officers.

exams.name: STCW Leadership and Managerial Skills
exams.blurb: Management-level STCW course on shipboard leadership, resource management, decision making and workload assessment.

exams.name: STCW Leadership and Teamwork
exams.blurb: Operational-level STCW course on teamwork, task allocation and effective communication aboard vessels for junior officers.

exams.name: STCW Medical Care Provider
exams.blurb: Advanced shipboard medical course covering patient assessment, medication administration and radio medical advice for masters and mates.

exams.name: STCW Medical First Aid Provider
exams.blurb: Approved course on immediate care of shipboard casualties including bleeding, burns, fractures, hypothermia and rescue breathing.

exams.name: Tankerman-Assistant Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Endorsement allowing a mariner to assist in cargo transfers of oil or hazardous liquids under the supervision of a person in charge.

exams.name: Tankerman-Engineer Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Endorsement for licensed engineers supervising transfer of fuel oil and bunkering operations aboard tank vessels.

exams.name: Tankerman-PIC (Barge) Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Restricted tankerman endorsement covering cargo transfers on tank barges rather than self-propelled tank vessels.

exams.name: Tankerman-PIC Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Endorsement authorising a mariner to act as person in charge of transferring dangerous liquid or liquefied gas cargo.

exams.name: Third Assistant Engineer Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Entry unlimited engineering officer licence requiring extensive Coast Guard examinations in motor, steam, gas turbine and electrical plants.

exams.name: Third Mate Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Entry unlimited deck officer licence for oceans service, examined across navigation, stability, cargo, safety and rules of the road.

exams.name: Transportation Worker Identification Credential
exams.blurb: Biometric identity card required for unescorted access to secure port areas and for all credentialed merchant mariners.

exams.name: USCG Chart Plot Exam Module
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Ten-question plotting module requiring 90 percent to pass, covering fixes, set and drift, courses to steer and estimated times of arrival.

exams.name: USCG Deck General Exam Module
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Examination module on seamanship, marlinespike, ship construction, stability and deck operations for master level credentials.

exams.name: USCG Deck Safety Exam Module
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Examination module covering firefighting, damage control, lifesaving equipment, pollution regulations and emergency procedures.

exams.name: USCG Navigation General Exam Module
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Fifty-question module on aids to navigation, tides and currents, compass error, weather and publications, requiring 90 percent to pass.

exams.name: USCG Rules of the Road Exam Module
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Module on International and Inland navigation rules, lights, shapes and sound signals requiring a 90 percent passing score.

exams.name: Vessel Personnel with Designated Security Duties
exams.blurb: STCW security training for crew assigned security tasks, covering threat recognition, screening, search and security equipment use.

exams.name: Vessel Security Officer Course
exams.blurb: Approved course for officers responsible for implementing and maintaining the ship security plan under the ISPS Code.

exams.name: Amateur Extra Class License Exam
exams.blurb: 50-question examination granting full amateur radio privileges, covering advanced theory, transmission lines and specialised operating rules.

exams.name: Amateur Radio General Class License Exam
exams.blurb: 35-question examination opening most high-frequency amateur bands, covering propagation, antennas, rules and station operation.

exams.name: Amateur Radio Technician Class License Exam
exams.blurb: Entry amateur radio examination of 35 questions on regulations, operating practice and electronics for VHF and UHF privileges.

exams.name: FCC Element 1 Basic Radio Law and Operating Practice
exams.blurb: 24-question examination on radio law and operating practice that underpins the Marine Radio Operator Permit and other commercial licences.

exams.name: FCC Element 3 General Radiotelephone
exams.blurb: 76-question technical examination on electronics, antennas and transmitters taken with Element 1 to earn the GROL.

exams.name: FCC Element 5 Radiotelegraph Operating Practice
exams.blurb: Written examination on radiotelegraph operating procedures and regulations required toward the Radiotelegraph Operator License.

exams.name: FCC Element 6 Advanced Radiotelegraph
exams.blurb: Technical examination on radiotelegraph equipment, installation and maintenance for the commercial radiotelegraph operator licence.

exams.name: FCC Element 7 GMDSS Radio Operating Practices
exams.blurb: 76-question examination on distress alerting, digital selective calling, Inmarsat and NAVTEX for the GMDSS operator licence.

exams.name: FCC Element 7R Restricted GMDSS Radio Operating Practices
exams.blurb: Examination covering GMDSS operating practices limited to sea area A1, leading to the restricted GMDSS operator licence.

exams.name: FCC Element 8 Ship Radar Techniques
exams.blurb: 50-question technical examination on radar theory, pulse circuits, magnetrons and alignment required for the radar endorsement.

exams.name: FCC Element 9 GMDSS Radio Maintenance Practices and Procedures
exams.blurb: 50-question examination on at-sea maintenance and repair of GMDSS equipment for the radio maintainer licence.

exams.name: General Radiotelephone Operator License
exams.blurb: Lifetime commercial licence earned by passing Elements 1 and 3, required to repair and maintain most ship and aircraft radio transmitters.

exams.name: GMDSS Radio Maintainer's License
exams.blurb: Licence earned through Elements 1, 3 and 9 authorising at-sea maintenance and repair of Global Maritime Distress and Safety System equipment.

exams.name: GMDSS Radio Operator's License
exams.blurb: Licence earned through Elements 1 and 7 authorising operation of GMDSS distress and safety communications equipment at sea.

exams.name: GMDSS Radio Operator/Maintainer License
exams.blurb: Combined licence covering both GMDSS operating and maintenance privileges, requiring Elements 1, 3, 7 and 9 to be passed.

exams.name: Marine Radio Operator Permit
exams.blurb: Permit obtained by passing Element 1, required to operate radiotelephone stations aboard many passenger and commercial vessels.

exams.name: Radiotelegraph Operator License
exams.blurb: Commercial licence requiring Elements 1, 5 and 6 plus Morse code proficiency for operating and maintaining radiotelegraph stations.

exams.name: Restricted GMDSS Radio Operator License
exams.blurb: Licence earned through Elements 1 and 7R for GMDSS operation on vessels trading only within VHF coverage of coast stations.

exams.name: Restricted Radiotelephone Operator Permit
exams.blurb: Lifetime permit issued without examination, commonly required by pilots flying internationally and by operators of certain radio stations.

exams.name: Restricted Radiotelephone Operator Permit Limited Use
exams.blurb: Permit variant issued to aircraft pilots and other operators who do not qualify for the standard restricted permit.

exams.name: Ship Radar Endorsement
exams.blurb: Endorsement added to a GROL or radiotelegraph licence by passing Element 8, required to service shipboard radar systems.

exams.name: Six Months Service Endorsement
exams.blurb: Endorsement documenting six months of shipboard radio service, needed for certain sole radio operator positions at sea.

exams.name: Aircraft Electronics Technician Certification
exams.blurb: Baseline avionics credential covering aircraft electrical fundamentals, wiring, soldering, EMI control and troubleshooting of onboard electronic systems.

exams.name: Aviation Maintenance Technician Airframe Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question FAA written test on airframe structures, systems and inspection required for the airframe rating of a mechanic certificate.

exams.name: Aviation Maintenance Technician Airframe Oral and Practical Test
exams.blurb: Examiner-administered oral questioning and hands-on projects covering airframe subject areas required before the airframe rating is issued.

exams.name: Aviation Maintenance Technician General Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question FAA written test covering basic electricity, weight and balance, materials, maintenance forms and regulations shared by all mechanics.

exams.name: Aviation Maintenance Technician General Oral and Practical Test
exams.blurb: Oral and practical examination on general maintenance subjects that every applicant must pass before receiving an airframe or powerplant rating.

exams.name: Aviation Maintenance Technician Powerplant Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question FAA written test on reciprocating and turbine engines, propellers, fuel and ignition systems for the powerplant rating.

exams.name: Aviation Maintenance Technician Powerplant Oral and Practical Test
exams.blurb: Oral questioning and hands-on engine projects assessed by a designated examiner before the powerplant rating is added to a mechanic certificate.

exams.name: Certified Aviation Manager
exams.blurb: Credential for business aviation leaders covering flight operations, human resources, technical services, facilities and aviation business management.

exams.name: FAA Repairman Certificate (Experimental Aircraft Builder)
exams.blurb: Certificate allowing the primary builder of an amateur-built aircraft to perform the annual condition inspection on that specific airplane.

exams.name: FAA Repairman Certificate (Light-Sport Aircraft Inspection Rating)
exams.blurb: Short-course credential permitting owners of special light-sport aircraft to carry out the required annual condition inspection.

exams.name: FAA Repairman Certificate (Light-Sport Aircraft Maintenance Rating)
exams.blurb: Credential earned through an approved 80 to 120 hour course authorising maintenance and inspection of light-sport aircraft by class.

exams.name: Inspection Authorization Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test for experienced A&P mechanics seeking Inspection Authorization to approve major repairs and perform annual inspections.

exams.name: Parachute Rigger Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: FAA written test covering parachute construction, packing, maintenance and record keeping for senior and master parachute rigger certificates.

exams.name: Parachute Rigger Military Competence Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: Abbreviated 25-question test for military-trained riggers converting service experience into an FAA parachute rigger certificate.
